blockingFindings.title: R3 impl-gate routing is not asserted
blockingFindings.rationale: R3 explicitly requires routing to `impl-gate`; without a spec-local assertion, an implementation could complete the earlier leaves but fail to route to the gate and still pass this test.
blockingFindings.issue: The R3 test verifies that flow impl-review, impl-triage, and impl-repair become done and that task-review is unchanged, but it never asserts that PASS/ADVISORY routes to impl-gate.
blockingFindings.requiredChange: Add an assertion in the R3 PASS/ADVISORY case that `impl-gate` is placed in the expected routed state, such as `in_progress` if that is the lifecycle convention.
blockingFindings.whyBlocking: R3 explicitly requires routing to `impl-gate`; without a spec-local assertion, an implementation could complete the earlier leaves but fail to route to the gate and still pass this test.

blockingFindings.title: R2 max-attempt precheck order is not covered against review-stop clearing
blockingFindings.rationale: R2 requires scope resolution once before clearing review stop state and using that decision for max-attempt precheck; the current tests allow a side effect before the precheck failure.
blockingFindings.issue: The exhausted max-attempt cases assert no subprocess after scope resolution, but they do not include review stop state or a flowManager mutation spy, so they cannot detect an implementation that clears review stop state before the max-attempt precheck returns `REVIEW_MAX_ATTEMPTS_EXCEEDED`.
blockingFindings.requiredChange: In at least one exhausted max-attempt case, initialize review stop/runtime review state, provide a flowManager that records mutation/metric/status calls, and assert the result occurs after only scope resolution with no durable mutation.
blockingFindings.whyBlocking: R2 requires scope resolution once before clearing review stop state and using that decision for max-attempt precheck; the current tests allow a side effect before the precheck failure.
